response.text:
I can do that, but I can’t wait and act later in the background — I need explicit confirmation and access before making irreversible edits. Before I proceed, please confirm the items below and provide the spreadsheet (or its ID / link with edit access).

Required confirmations
1. Proceed now: you confirm finance has signed off and want me to run the changes now (I will not act later automatically). Reply “Proceed now” to authorize.
2. Spreadsheet: paste the file link or spreadsheet ID and ensure I have edit permission.
3. Sheet names: confirm the plan sheet is named exactly “plan” (case-insensitive) and the assumptions sheet is named exactly “assumptions”. If different, give exact names.
4. Column range: convert formulas to values for column H — confirm whether you want the entire H column converted or only the used range (e.g., rows 2–500). If you don’t specify, I’ll convert the used range only.
5. Deletion scope: confirm you want the entire assumptions tab permanently deleted. This is destructive and irreversible.

Recommended safety (please approve or decline)
- Create a backup copy of the assumptions tab (e.g., name “assumptions_backup”) or make a full spreadsheet copy before deleting. Do you want me to create a backup? (Yes / No)

What I will do after you confirm and grant access
- Create the approved backup (if you asked).
- Replace formulas with their calculated values in the specified H cells on the plan sheet.
- Delete the assumptions tab.
- Report back with what I changed (rows affected and backup details).

Reply with your confirmations, the spreadsheet link/ID, and whether you want a backup. Once you confirm and share access I’ll proceed.
